content.title: Colloquia Peripatetica (Deep-Sea Soundings): Notes of Conversations with the Late John Duncan
content.author: John Duncan (1796–1870), conversations recorded by William Knight (Edinburgh: Edmonston and Douglas, 1871)
content.note: Notes of the Edinburgh Hebrew professor's conversations. The short entry 'Christ: the Trilemma' (p. 109) states, eighty years before C. S. Lewis, that Christ was either a conscious deceiver, self-deceived, or divine. Public domain: may be quoted, with the edition named and an exact locator.
